<a id="the-counterfactual-is-the-course--反事实是规律的进程"></a>
# The counterfactual is the course

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`counterfactual-is-the-course` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](counterfactual-is-the-course.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading what has stood, the counterfactual of an act is the course that law generates: fixed by the act, balanced exactly where feasible, and compared within the responsive reach with neither the second flow nor the response supplied.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A law of exchange reads, off a level history, what each formation takes from and gives to each condition across step t; it reads what has stood when, for two histories agreeing up to step t, it gives alike at step t. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw`, `Becoming.AgreeUpTo`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.GivesAlike`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating`)
2. For two flows, two webs and a part (a decided family of formations), a flow follows the law outside the part when every formation outside it exchanges as the law gives under the flow's own levels; the part acts alike in two flows when its exchange is the same in both. (`Becoming.Flow.Follows`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsAlike`)
3. The counterfactual is fixed by the act: two balanced flows with the same formations present at every step, starting alike, in which the part acts alike and the rest follows one law reading what has stood, have the same level of every condition at every step, and every formation takes from and gives to every condition alike at every step. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances`, `Becoming.levels_fixed`, `Becoming.counterfactual_fixed`)
4. Generation: the law generates a history, levels and a flow step by step from starting levels, the orbit of one determined law on the stage and the history so far; every formation follows the law in the generated flow. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.history`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.levels`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.history_orbit`, `Becoming.Law.orbit`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course_follows`)
5. Feasibility: where the law reads what has stood, the generated flow balances exactly where the course is feasible, the law never taking from a condition more than stands on it and is given to it. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Feasible`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course_balances_iff`)
6. With the part acting by another law reading what has stood and the rest by the law, a balanced flow in which the part acts as in that course and the rest follows the law, starting at the course's starting levels, has the course's levels and exchange, where the course is feasible. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.withAct`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.withAct_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.counterfactual_is_course`)
7. Where every formation follows one law reading what has stood, a balanced flow is the course the law generates, where the course is feasible. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course_unique`)
8. Responding through the couplings follows: the law reads through the couplings when, for every formation outside the part, two histories alike through its couplings under the first web up to step t give alike at step t; then the rest responds through its couplings in any two courses of the law. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.responds`, `Becoming.Flow.RespondsThroughCoupling`)
9. Every law of what has stood reads through the coupling of everything; a formation's exchange is sensitive to a condition when at some step changing that condition's levels alone changes it. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_all`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Sensitive`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.InsensitiveAt`)
10. With finitely many conditions (a list holding every condition) and decidable equality of conditions, a law of what has stood reads through every coupling by which what it is sensitive to couples in by level, so through its sensitivity itself, by changing one condition at a time. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_of_observed`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating.through_sensitive`, `Becoming.mixIn_alike`, `Becoming.alike_of_sensitive_agree`)
11. Conversely, every coupling a law reads through, with what the formation depends on, leaves out no condition the exchange is sensitive to (double-negated); no sensitivity is decided, only whether two numbers are equal. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.Through.couples_of_sensitive`, `Becoming.nat_eq_of_not_not`)
12. The comparison: for two balanced courses of the law with the same formations present, starting alike, the law reading through a coupling, any significance covering every formation not beyond the responsive reach drawn through that coupling (double-negated) makes each retain along the other exactly as it includes it, and neither add exactly where neither exceeds. (`Becoming.comparison_of_courses`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.comparison_within_response`)
13. With finitely many conditions the coupling is the law's sensitivity; likewise with the second flow the feasible course another act generates, with neither the second flow nor the response supplied. (`Becoming.comparison_through_sensitivity`, `Becoming.comparison_with_act`)
14. The standard causal model: the history generated where the part makes a list of moves and the rest follows the law is a trajectory of the standard model whose input is the part's move, with no noise. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.ofMoves`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.stepBy`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course_trajectory`, `Becoming.inputs`, `Becoming.trajectory`)
15. Where a run of that model has not taken move a at x before step t, the record does not fix its outcome and the model does, an instance of the model's laws of intervention. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.act_not_taken`, `Becoming.inputs_intervention_unfixed`, `Becoming.inputs_model_fixes`)
16. Witness: in the escalation loop the second formation's reply is a law (in the step after its own condition falls it takes two units from the first's condition), reading what has stood and only what the second observes; the flows with and without the act both follow it, so the response follows from the law (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds at Loop.replyLaw_through; the response is Loop.responds), and each flow is fixed by the first's act. (`Becoming.Loop.replyLaw`, `Becoming.Loop.replyLaw_nonanticipating`, `Becoming.Loop.replyLaw_through`, `Becoming.Loop.escalation_follows`, `Becoming.Loop.quiet_follows`, `Becoming.Loop.responds`, `Becoming.Loop.courses_fixed`)
17. As an unfolding: where formations and conditions are one kind of relatum, the course is a world, its web read at the generated levels; where the law reads what has stood, that world balances, and so its levels run by the law of exchange with its relata's exchanges as moves, exactly where the course is feasible. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.world`, `Becoming.World`, `Becoming.Web.withLevel`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.course_balances_iff`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.world_exchange_iff`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.worldRun`, `Becoming.exchange`)
18. A determined law steps from s by a beyond what a run of it shows exactly where it steps there at all and the run never takes a at s; this holds for any determined law. (`Becoming.Determined`, `Becoming.Shown`, `Becoming.Run.beyond_shown_iff`)
19. So for a run of the course's standard model, its history shows a determined law, and the part's move a at x has a step of the model beyond what the history shows exactly where the history never takes a at x. (`Becoming.Consistent`, `Becoming.exists_law_iff`, `Becoming.inputs_determined`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.counterfactual_beyond_shown`)
20. Where the part's move is formed by a law on the configuration (the stage and the history so far), a run closed by it from the starting levels is at every step the course the law with that act generates, so two such runs agree. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.policy`, `Becoming.closedBy`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.closedBy_course`, `Becoming.closedBy_runs_agree`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The law of exchange is supplied: which law the rest follows (ExchangeLaw, Flow.Follows) is not derived.
- That the law reads what has stood (ExchangeLaw.Nonanticipating) is a hypothesis of laws 3, 5–7, 9, 10, 13 and 17 and of ExchangeLaw.totals_under; laws 8 and 12 take instead that the law reads through a coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through).
- Feasibility of the course (ExchangeLaw.Feasible) is a hypothesis of comparison_with_act, counterfactual_is_course and ExchangeLaw.course_unique; course_balances_iff proves it equivalent to the generated flow's balance.
- The sensitivity forms (alike_of_sensitive_agree, through_of_observed, through_sensitive, comparison_through_sensitivity) assume finitely many conditions, a list holding every condition, and decidable equality of conditions; only whether two numbers are equal is decided, never sensitivity; couples_of_sensitive concludes a double negation.
- The comparison laws as in comparison-where-the-rest-responds: the actual flow balances throughout (Flow.Balances), the two flows have the same formations present at every step, and they start alike; the significance sig is supplied, and the cover is double-negated.
- counterfactual_fixed and counterfactual_is_course ask the part to act alike value by value (Flow.ActsAlike); where the part acts by a strategy reading the levels, ExchangeLaw.course_unique applies, with the part's strategy taken into the law.
- For the Loop results: the witness's flows, webs and part, and the second formation's law Loop.replyLaw.
- The instances in the unfolding: the world forms ask that formations and conditions be one kind of relatum (ExchangeLaw R R); Run.beyond_shown_iff asks that the law be determined; closedBy_course asks that the run begin at the starting levels with the move formed there, the part's move being formed by a law act on the configuration (act need not read what has stood); it does not derive when a move is the part's own.
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels and amounts, with truncated subtraction.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which law the rest follows is supplied, as is its reading what has stood; neither follows here.
- Responding through the couplings follows near-definitionally; the substance is the act fixing the counterfactual, generation as feasibility, sensitivity as least coupling, the causal-model instance and the loop from the law.
- The premise moves onto the law: responses to what does not couple in, noise and unrepresented inputs fall within the law's sensitivity, so the responsive reach widens rather than excluding them.
- Whether sensitivity remains the least coupling with infinitely many conditions is not stated, and no counterexample is given.
- A law sensitive to the level of a condition the formation only depends on does not read through a coupling holding only that dependence (dependence asks only that it be admitted alike).
- An infeasible act has no course, and no other reading of it is given; the part's acts are alike value by value or given by a law.
- The responsive reach is still an upper bound, with no measure of how much difference arrives and no order in time; the loop is a minimal witness (one response), not a general theory of loops.
- The unfolding instances are near-definitional: the world's balance restates the course's, and the step beyond what a run shows holds for any determined law and is one step, not a whole course; nothing says when a move is the part's own.
- **Counterexample:** The record does not fix the counterfactual: where a run of the model whose input is the part's move has not taken move a at x before step t, the record does not fix its outcome (ExchangeLaw.act_not_taken); only the law fixes it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A coupling given in advance can be too narrow: where the law is sensitive to a condition that couples into the formation neither by threshold nor by level, the law does not read through that coupling (the contrapositive of ExchangeLaw.Through.couples_of_sensitive); the responsive reach must be drawn through the law's sensitivity, and widens. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren wrote: “another agent has got this far, maybe merge first and see if there is something to work on”. The AI then took up the chapter's open item that joins the comparison where the rest responds: “a comparison in which others respond as the dynamics give, not through a second flow supplied”; that record states which hypotheses its theorem still takes, and this one states the new laws. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): a counterfactual is not a second world beside the actual one but the course of the same law where the part acts otherwise, existing where feasible and fixed by the act (the AI relates this to Ren's “there are no two realities”); for a rest following a law of what has stood, responding through the couplings is no further assumption about how formations behave: whatever such law the rest follows, with finitely many conditions it reads through its sensitivity: what couples into a formation is what its exchange is sensitive to; an act not taken is an intervention in the sense of the standard causal model. Further readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): the course of an act not taken has the form of every unfolding, not a second kind of thing; what a law adds beyond the history it governs is exactly the moves the history never takes, so a counterfactual is the law's step beyond its history, not a second history beside it; with the part's move formed within the unfolding by a law, the course is fixed from the start, and acting otherwise is a law of the part otherwise.
